scoring_justification: The artifact consists of computed thermal expansion curves; the checker compares these against digitized reference values extracted from the paper's own experimental validation figures using MAPE. Recompute from raw artifacts (T1) is infeasible because the checker sandbox would need the full Fe–C phase diagram data and solver to re-run the model, which cannot be bundled.

hidden_assets.purpose: Reference alpha_B and alpha_C values for the thermal expansion curves across temperatures 200–900 °C at 50 °C steps.
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Digitized from the paper's Fig. 1 and Fig. 2 (curves B and C) following the published experimental validation.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Author manually digitized approximate values from the printed figures, preserving the overall shape and magnitude of the reported curves.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: Values are directly derived from the paper's own figures that validate the model; they are not invented but represent the experimental ground truth the paper presents.

schema.description: temperature_C: temperature in degrees Celsius (integer); alpha_B: thermal expansion coefficient without plastic deformation (10^-6 /K, float); alpha_C: thermal expansion coefficient with plastic deformation (10^-6 /K, float).

outputs.description: Computed thermal expansion coefficient of cast iron for two model variants as a function of temperature.

output_contract.notes: The model uses publicly available Fe–C phase diagram data, lattice expansion coefficients, and standard physical constants. The checker will recompute a metric from this artifact and compare against hidden reference values digitized from the paper's figures.
